title: I Lift My Eyes to the Hills

request.style: English, bluegrass gospel, a cappella three-part harmony at first, then banjo, fiddle and mandolin come in, Appalachian mountain sound, mid-tempo, 108 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I lift my eyes up to the hills
Where does my help come from
My help comes from the Lord above
Who made the heaven and earth

[Chorus]
He will not let your foot slip
He who keeps you will not sleep
The Lord will watch your going out
And your coming in

[Verse]
The Lord is your keeper and your shade
Upon your right hand
The sun won't strike you in the day
Nor the moon by night

[Chorus]
He will not let your foot slip
He who keeps you will not sleep
The Lord will watch your going out
And your coming in
